mapper.sql: SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.ITEM_ID, i.CONTENT AS ITEM_TITLE, s.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, u.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, s.BASE_GRADE, s.BASE_SCORE, s.DIFFICULTY, s.SCOPE_CHANGE, s.RISK_HANDLING, s.WEIGHT_FACTOR, s.FINAL_SCORE, s.APPROVAL_STATUS, s.APPROVED_BY, s.APPROVED_AT, s.REQUEST_DATE, s.DUE_DATE, s.COMPLETED_AT, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, s.DELETED_AT, s.DELETED_BY FROM TB_ITEM_SCORE s LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM i ON s.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON s.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = u.USERNAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITEM_SCORE ( ITEM_ID, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, BASE_GRADE, BASE_SCORE, DIFFICULTY, SCOPE_CHANGE, RISK_HANDLING, WEIGHT_FACTOR, FINAL_SCORE, APPROVAL_STATUS, REQUEST_DATE, DUE_DATE, COMPLETED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{assigneeUsername}, #{baseGrade}, #{baseScore}, COALESCE(#{difficulty}, 1), COALESCE(#{scopeChange}, 0), COALESCE(#{riskHandling}, 0), #{weightFactor}, #{finalScore}, COALESCE(#{approvalStatus}, 'APPROVED'), #{requestDate}, #{dueDate}, #{completedAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM_SCORE SET BASE_GRADE = #{baseGrade}, BASE_SCORE = #{baseScore}, DIFFICULTY = #{difficulty}, SCOPE_CHANGE = #{scopeChange}, RISK_HANDLING = #{riskHandling}, WEIGHT_FACTOR = #{weightFactor}, FINAL_SCORE = #{finalScore} WHERE SCORE_ID = #{scoreId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM_SCORE SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{status}, APPROVED_BY = #{approvedBy}, APPROVED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SCORE_ID = #{scoreId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM_SCORE SET DIFFICULTY = #{difficulty}, SCOPE_CHANGE = #{scopeChange}, RISK_HANDLING = #{riskHandling}, WEIGHT_FACTOR = #{weightFactor}, FINAL_SCORE = #{finalScore} WHERE SCORE_ID = #{scoreId}
